changelog: FIX: Movies and TV series now display the correct show/episode name during playback instead of a raw stream number.
FEATURE: FireStick remote Rewind, Fast Forward, and Play/Pause hardware keys now fully control the player.

FEATURE: Expanded CC and subtitle options in the player — includes Disable CC toggle, per-track naming improvements, and a Subtitle Delay control (±100ms / ±500ms nudge) accessible from the subtitle picker.

FEATURE: New 'LibVLC' tab in Settings with full engine tuning options — Audio Output module (AudioTrack / OpenSL ES), Audio Resampler, Display Chroma format, Subtitle encoding, Drop Late Frames, Skip Frames, Clock Jitter, Network MTU, and Verbose Logging.
IMPROVEMENT: Subtitle text encoding selector (Auto / UTF-8 / Latin-1 / Win-1252 / KOI8-R) to fix garbled subtitle text for international content.
Under the hood: LibVLC initialization now reads all engine settings from the new LibVLC settings tab.
